invariants.rationale: A valid commit instant typically requires a non-null instantTime.
partitionRecordsMap is passed to an internal method and should not be null.
Partition records map is either empty or not; covers two valid states, though not semantically deep.
The keySet of any non-null map is never null per the Java Map contract.
If partitionRecordsMap contains the instantTime key, then instantTime cannot be null.
